body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Calling `resize_()` on an intermediate tensor works in eager mode, but the compiled version crashes when using `torch.compile(..., mode="max-autotune")`.
## Reproduction

```python
    import torch

    def resize_tensor(x):
        value = x[0].clone()
        x.resize_(5)
        x.zero_()
        x[0] = value
        return x


    def f(x, weight):
        y = torch.mv(weight, x)
        y = resize_tensor(y)
        return y.square()


    x = torch.randn(32, device="cuda")
    weight = torch.randn(1, 32, device="cuda")

    print("eager:", f(x, weight))
    compiled_f = torch.compile(f, mode="max-autotune")
    print("compiled:", compiled_f(x, weight))
```
